hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.command // ""' | grep -qE 'server/utils/db\.ts$|sqlite3 .*wealth.*\.db|rm .*data/wealth' && cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && mkdir -p data/backups && for f in data/wealth.*.db; do [ -f "$f" ] && sqlite3 "$f" ".backup 'data/backups/$(basename "$f" .db).$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).db'"; done 2>/dev/null; true
hooks.statusMessage: Backing up SQLite db before schema/db change
